site_text: Larkmoor Comfort Heating & Air is a family-owned HVAC contractor in Larkmoor, Ohio: furnace and air conditioner repair, replacement, the Comfort Club maintenance plan, and commercial maintenance agreements across the north and east Columbus suburbs. Larkmoor Comfort Heating & Air Family-owned heating and air conditioning (HVAC) contractor since 1994. Service, repair and installation for homes and commercial buildings in Larkmoor, Westerville, Gahanna, New Albany, Delaware and the north and east Columbus suburbs of Ohio. Call (614) 555-0142 service@larkmoorcomfort.example Heating and cooling service and repair Furnaces, heat pumps, central air conditioners, ductless mini-splits, humidifiers and thermostats. Our licensed technicians repair all major brands. Same-day service when the schedule allows; after-hours emergency service through our answering service. System replacement When repair no longer makes sense, a Comfort Advisor visits your home, measures the house and gives you written options. Our install crews replace about 300 home systems a year. We are an authorized dealer for Aerovance heating and cooling equipment. Comfort Club maintenance plan Two tune-ups a year (spring cooling, fall heating), priority scheduling, no overtime charges and 15% off repairs. $189 per year. More than 600 neighbors are members. Commercial HVAC Preventive maintenance agreements, rooftop unit (RTU) service and replacement for offices, retail centers, churches, schools and property managers. Our commercial team maintains equipment for about 90 buildings in central Ohio. Request service Name Phone Address What is going on? Send request Requests sent through this form go to our office inbox. For no heat or no cooling, please call. About us Glen and Ruth Vossberg started Larkmoor Comfort in 1994 with one truck. Today about 35 people work here, including 14 service technicians and two install crews. Ohio HVAC contractor license on file. Hours: Monday to Friday 7:30 am to 5:00 pm; emergency service after hours. Follow us on Facebook . Larkmoor Comfort Heating & Air, Inc. | 2290 Fenwick Road, Larkmoor, OH | (614) 555-0142 Fictional company created for an academic test case. scored_opportunities.name: Intake Triage & Routing Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Parses incoming phone calls, web forms, and answering service transcripts to extract customer details, HVAC symptoms, urgency level, and property type, then drafts a dispatch ticket.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual data entry from paper/online forms and call routing delays.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value by cutting intake time and reducing missed calls; moderate effort requires telephony/web form integration; low risk as dispatchers verify critical details before assignment.

scored_opportunities.name: Dynamic Route & Priority Optimizer
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Analyzes technician locations, certifications, van inventory, and job urgency to auto-suggest optimal daily routes and assignments, flagging scheduling conflicts.
scored_opportunities.gap: Reliance on manual tracking tools (whiteboard/spreadsheet) leading to double-booking or missed priorities.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value directly addresses operational bottlenecks and fuel costs; medium effort due to real-time calendar/GPS integration complexity; moderate risk managed by mandatory dispatcher approval.

scored_opportunities.name: First-Trip Parts Predictor
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Reviews symptom descriptions and historical job data to predict likely replacement parts, pre-stocking technician vans or triggering warehouse orders before dispatch.
scored_opportunities.gap: Travel time management and parts availability tracking (technicians making extra trips).
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Strong value by cutting costly second service calls; medium effort requires historical data structuring and ML model training; low risk as incorrect predictions only result in minor schedule adjustments.

scored_opportunities.name: Automated Quote Generator
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Processes Comfort Advisor field notes and property photos to auto-generate compliant HVAC replacement quotes with pricing tiers, efficiency ratings, and financing options.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual measurement/data collection and delayed quote generation (customers wait days).
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value accelerates sales cycle and reduces manual quoting hours; medium effort involves multimodal processing and pricing logic; low risk ensured by mandatory Comfort Advisor review before sending.

scored_opportunities.name: Renewal & Tune-Up Scheduler
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Monitors subscription expiration dates and contract terms, auto-schedules bi-annual maintenance windows, and sends personalized renewal reminders with upgrade options.
scored_opportunities.gap: Tracking renewal dates manually and scheduling bi-annual tune-ups (high churn, missed revenue).
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Very high value directly protects recurring revenue streams; low effort due to straightforward database triggers and messaging automation; minimal risk as errors are easily corrected with customer opt-out.

scored_opportunities.name: Invoice & AR Follow-Up Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Converts paper service tickets into formatted invoices, matches them to open contracts or POs, and auto-sends payment reminders for overdue accounts.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual invoice creation from paper tickets and delayed payment follow-up (cash flow delays).
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value improves cash flow and reduces accounts receivable days; medium effort requires OCR and accounting system sync; low risk as human accounting staff verify all invoices before dispatch.

roadmaps.rationale: Starting with the scheduler establishes a reliable revenue foundation before introducing any new customer touchpoints. Adding invoicing automation next streamlines financial operations and reduces manual data entry errors across the board. Prioritizing intake triage last ensures that new service requests are properly captured and routed only after the backend financial and retention systems are running smoothly.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The scheduler is piloted first because it requires no changes to field operations or customer communication channels, allowing the owner to verify system reliability before scaling.
roadmaps.assumption: The company must maintain consistent data hygiene across customer accounts to ensure automated scheduling and billing align correctly.

rubric.objection: The Intake Triage & Routing Agent introduces a new layer of complexity to the customer service process, potentially increasing errors if not carefully implemented and monitored.

roadmaps.rationale: Beginning with the scheduler minimizes operational disruption while securing predictable recurring revenue. Introducing invoicing automation next addresses cash flow and administrative errors without impacting field technicians or customer interactions. Reserving the parts predictor for last ensures that complex predictive algorithms are only deployed after foundational financial and customer processes are fully automated.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The scheduler is piloted first because it operates entirely on existing administrative data and poses zero risk to active service calls or technician safety.
roadmaps.assumption: The business must consistently track and update customer expiration dates to prevent missed renewals or billing errors.

rubric.objection: The First-Trip Parts Predictor, while valuable, introduces complexity and potential inaccuracies that could negatively impact field operations.

roadmaps.rationale: Starting with the scheduler captures recurring revenue and strengthens customer relationships before tackling complex operational changes. Prioritizing route optimization next ensures that increased maintenance volume is handled efficiently by technicians without causing dispatch bottlenecks. Finishing with invoicing automation secures cash flow and reduces administrative friction once the customer base is actively engaged.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The scheduler serves as the pilot because it directly generates immediate revenue and requires minimal technical integration, making it safe for a cautious owner to validate the concept.
roadmaps.assumption: The business must maintain accurate, up-to-date customer contract records for the automation to function correctly.

rubric.objection: The Dynamic Route & Priority Optimizer, while high value, carries a risk rating that may exceed the owner's comfort level given their 0.4 risk tolerance.
